summary: Q4 revenue was only modestly above consensus, but $3.23 adjusted EPS, 50.4% gross margin and 36.6% operating margin cleared the true bar. More decisively, Q1 guidance of $1.225B-$1.275B, $4.05-$4.35 EPS and 39.5%-40.5% operating margin substantially exceeded the already-elevated forward bar, confirming accelerating AI-optics conversion; the GAAP loss was a one-time non-cash debt-extinguishment charge. LITE warrants a strong positive repricing, with COHR a smaller industry-demand and optical-economics read-through.
